reviewer: Codex visual comparison of reference/neutral/authored sheets; colour differences allowed by user
legacy_policy: Migrate prior ranked-gallery acceptance, except the four explicit needs-work decisions below. This is not a fresh rerender or new review of all original 50.

rows.note: Authored rendering is mostly black with red edge highlights; substantial scene content is obscured. Keep outside the showcase until illumination is repaired.
Authored scene remains substantially underlit, especially upper and background structures. Preserve the historical comparison but exclude from the showcase.
Known production float32 position stalls leave unresolved geometry misses; the offline diagnostic is not a production fix.
Known major deep-zoom production geometry failure. Higher-precision diagnostic output is not substituted in the gallery.

Authored silhouette and framing align after water support. Neutral water dominates the white control; authored orange material is flatter and the reflected sky differs. Accept broad structure, not water transport parity.
Refreshed authored image is still dark red/black where native objects are clearly green/gold. Geometry is visible in neutral mode, but darkness obscures authored structure.
Tree silhouette and framing align. FPT is brighter/yellower and uses a different blue sky; colour differences do not obscure the structure.
Refreshed crystal arrangement, curved ridges, orientation and broad colours closely match the reference. Minor highlights differ.
Red spherical silhouette and surface pattern align. Both views are dark red; FPT contrast is softer, but the shape remains readable.
Cutouts, silhouette and orientation align clearly. Native cyan becomes magenta; accepted as a palette difference, not material parity.
Nested rings, close-up framing and visible openings align. FPT reflections and brightness differ without hiding the main structure.
Cap/stem silhouette and framing align. FPT replaces glossy orange highlights with a flatter red/orange material.
Refreshed rocket components, orientation, framing and broad colours align. Remaining differences are small shading changes.
Refreshed surface light is present, but native orange illumination remains absent across most of the view. Large regions stay too dark for the showcase; volumetric effects remain deferred.
Only small cyan light patches remain bright in authored FPT, with most native blue-lit beams and surrounding structure lost in darkness. Neutral controls are needed for the ambiguous geometry.
Central spiral is similarly placed, but FPT fills much more of the image with sharp structure. Depth-of-field versus actual geometry must be isolated before acceptance.
Main green structure and framing align and remain readable. Native blue atmospheric fill is absent; background contrast and materials differ.
Refreshed spheres align, but the warm native glass is heavily clipped yellow/white in FPT. Lost material contrast is more than an acceptable palette change.
Large central surfaces and framing align. FPT is sharper/orange and native blur differs; fine depth and material parity are not certified.
Refreshed water surface and red sphere are restored; broad cavern framing matches. Reflections, saturation and sphere roughness still differ.

Refreshed box/displacement path restores the cavern instead of the earlier incorrect close surfaces. Broad opening and rock placement now align; blue contrast, highlights and fine cave detail remain imperfect.
Central ornament placement and surrounding forms broadly align. Native soft focus becomes sharper and more contrasty in FPT.
Large branches align, but much of the native atmospheric structure disappears into near-black areas. Bright foreground branches alone are insufficient for visual acceptance.
Broad rocky layout and framing align. Different focus, tan materials and sky response are visible; fine-depth fidelity is not claimed.
Curved foreground forms remain clear and similarly placed. Pink/yellow native environment becomes dark blue with chrome surfaces; accepted with strong material/environment caveats.
Rounded corridor features and camera framing align. FPT replaces olive highlights with reddish lower-contrast shading.
Cave pillars, water/floor extent and framing broadly align. Native reflective highlights and floor response differ.
Cave walls and pillar positions align, with the structure clearly readable. Patterned green FPT materials differ from native highlights.
Production refresh still replaces the open native beam lattice with black bars and displaced-looking detail. The successful offline precision prototype is not the production renderer.
Broad silhouette, placement and main surface forms align. FPT green is darker and more saturated than the native chrome response.
Bowl-like structure, large openings and framing align. Reflections, brightness and fine edge detail differ.
Broad geometry and framing closely align. Gold is darker and less glossy in FPT, without hiding the repeated forms.

Refreshed monoscopic image closely aligns the central disks and surrounding objects. Fine ring lighting differs. Native stereo is explicitly disabled for this reference; stereo support is not certified.
Disk framing aligns, but many bright native ring highlights disappear into a dark authored FPT surface. Hold for illumination/material work.
Terrain silhouette aligns but becomes substantially darker against an orange sky, and native sun disks are absent. The terrain is insufficiently exposed for the showcase.
Foreground structure and framing align and remain visible. Authored FPT is much brighter and more saturated; accepted with a strong palette/exposure caveat.
Lattice framing broadly aligns, but the missing light shaft and very dark surrounding surfaces hide significant native content. Volume and surface-light differences remain separate issues.
Broad lattice and framing align; major surfaces remain readable. Native glow and stronger illumination are absent, so this is not a volumetric-lighting match.
Broad ribbed shapes and framing align. Native softer focus and brighter highlights differ from the sharper, darker FPT material.
Large folds and warm colours align. FPT contains sharper high-frequency detail and different reflections; fine-detail identity is not claimed.
Geometry placement aligns, but very bright pink/orange FPT output clips the native material contrast. Hold for exposure/transport investigation rather than colour grading the capture.
Broad landscape and openings align. Native haze becomes sharper, saturated green/orange shading; fog remains out of scope.
Foreground mass is similarly placed but the background and visible depth coverage differ substantially. A neutral reference/DOF control is needed before calling it an acceptable geometry match.
Terrain silhouettes and framing align. Native sun disk is absent and FPT is greener/flatter; scene structure remains readable.
Large terrain forms align, but foreground structure loses native golden illumination and becomes very dark. Hold for lighting/material work.
Refreshed water surface is restored and the central object's placement aligns. Wave detail, reflected lighting and shadows differ; 32-SPP water noise remains visible.
Refreshed ridge and foreground surface framing align. Native haze and fine highlights differ from the sharper blue FPT terrain; fine structural parity is not certified.
Newton silhouette, openings and loops align clearly. Native reflective gold becomes saturated orange/red with a different environment gradient.
Large Newton arcs and framing align. Native soft golden shading/haze becomes sharper saturated red/yellow detail; fine background fidelity is not certified.
Branching Newton silhouette and major gaps align. FPT colours and environment gradient differ substantially but do not hide the structure.
Newton silhouette, framing and branching placement align. FPT is more saturated orange with different highlights and background lighting.
Broad Newton silhouette and openings align. Brighter yellow highlights and a different environment gradient remain.
Newton coil placement and framing align clearly. Native gold becomes saturated orange/red; reflection and environment differences remain.
Newton coils and framing align. FPT interiors are smoother/darker orange and the environment gradient differs.
